Self.Wiki: This map object represents an environmental map point in the map.

EnvMapPoint_UnkT00.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. Values such as 20-1000 (mostly 22 or 44).

EnvMapPoint_UnkT04.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. 4 on most points, also 2, 3, 10.

EnvMapPoint_UnkT0C.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. 1 on every retail point but one.

EnvMapPoint_UnkT0D.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. 1 on most points, 0 on 5.

EnvMapPoint_UnkT0F.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. 1 on most points, 0 on 101.

EnvMapPoint_UnkT10.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. 1, or 0.5 on 3 points.

EnvMapPoint_UnkT18.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. A packed value (8389120 on most points).

EnvMapPoint_UnkT1C.Wiki: Not seen read by the game. A packed value (17171456 on most points).

EnvMapPoint_UnkT20.Wiki: Read by the game (as a 16-bit value). Values such as 100-225, matching the env map effect boxes' Unknown: 0x32.
